channel.title: Brazil Elections 2026
channel.description: Real-time monitoring of the 2026 Brazilian presidential elections.

item.title: 'Esse é o verdadeiro ungido de Deus', diz Janja sobre Lula em comício no PI
item.description: First Lady Janja declared during a rally in Piauí that 'this is the true chosen one of God,' referring to her husband Lula. The statement was an indirect response to former First Lady Michelle Bolsonaro. The speech took place in Teresina, rallying support for the Lula administration.

item.title: Ruas chama Lula de “cara de pau” ao comentar adesão do Rio ao Propag
item.description: State deputy Douglas Ruas (PL), a candidate for Rio governor, criticized President Lula (PT) for vetoing Propag provisions that, he claimed, would benefit Rio. Ruas called Lula 'impudent' during a radio interview on BandNews FM.

item.title: A ferramenta que tenta prever o vencedor das eleições 2026
item.description: The co-founder of Voga Inteligência, João Pedro Pádua, explains how the Iris model uses survey data to estimate the electoral chances of Lula and Flávio Bolsonaro, currently tied at 50%. On Papo Antagonista, Duda Teixeira and Carlos Graeib also comment on the rise in Lula's disapproval in the Lulômetro and the testimony of Antônio Carlos.

item.title: PT aciona STF contra sigilo no caso Master
item.description: PT filed a motion at the STF requesting the suspension of secrecy regarding investigations involving public officials and Banco Master. The request came hours after President Lula's statements on transparency in the investigation. The case raises debates about campaign funding and economic elite influence.

item.title: AGU diz que decisão de Fachin restaura ordem pública e administrativa
item.description: The decision by Minister Edson Fachin to suspend the dismissal of Andrei Rodrigues was deemed positive by the AGU, restoring public and administrative order. The measure reinforces presidential authority over PF positions and strengthens STF institutionality. The Ministry of Justice ensured the independence of PF investigations.

item.title: Mendonça proíbe propaganda de Caiado afirmando que o PT ‘invadia terras’
item.description: Supreme Court Minister André Mendonça partially banned Ronaldo Caiado's campaign ad linking the PT to land invasions, noting the party is not directly involved with the MST. The ruling distinguished between criticizing PT's ties to rural movements and accusing the party of conducting invasions. Mendonça has not yet ruled on Lula's coalition's right of reply.

item.title: Cury propõe fim do presidencialismo no Brasil e premiê liberal
item.description: Augusto Cury, presidential candidate from Avante, proposed abolishing Brazil's presidential system and creating a prime minister responsible for the economy. The statement was made after a meeting at FIESP headquarters in São Paulo.

item.title: Janja: "Se dependesse do Bolsonaro, os nordestinos estavam comendo capim"
item.description: First Lady Janja criticized Jair Bolsonaro's potential return to government, arguing his agenda is personal and harmed the Northeast. She emphasized the Lula administration as an alternative that cares for the Brazilian people.

item.title: Decisão de Dino é manobra jurídica questionável que sucede erros de Mendonça, dizem especialistas
item.description: Supreme Court Justice Flávio Dino reinstated Andrei Rodrigues as head of the Federal Police, overturning a prior ruling by fellow Justice André Mendonça. Legal experts consulted by Folha consider the move a questionable legal maneuver, raising concerns about decision-making consistency within Brazil's highest court.

item.title: Com convocados, Corinthians está escalado para duelo contra o Estudiantes
item.description: Corinthians faces Estudiantantes in the first leg of the Libertadores quarterfinals with a strengthened squad featuring three players called up to the Brazilian national team. With only minor lineup changes from the previous match, the team aims to break its away knockout game winless streak that dates back to 2012.

item.title: Governo e Congresso deverão propor código único para rastrear emendas parlamentares, decide Dino
item.description: Supreme Court Minister Flávio Dino ordered the federal government and Congress to create a unique code to track parliamentary amendments, linking them to funding allocations and beneficiaries. The measure aims to increase transparency and has a deadline of November 30th.

item.title: Ancelotti cumpre promessa em primeira convocação pós-Copa, com oito estreias na Seleção Brasileira
item.description: Carlo Ancelotti called up the Brazilian National Team with eight newcomers for the 2026 World Cup friendly matches, keeping his promise to scout new talents. The games will be held against Australia and India, focusing on developing future generations towards the 2030 World Cup.

item.title: O grupo eleitoral que pode decidir a eleição de 2026
item.description: Renato Meirelles, president of Instituto Locomotiva, explains that class C, representing 53% of voters, is divided between conservative and progressive sectors. He highlights that preferences range from elderly grateful for the first Lula government to younger voters leaning right, shaping the 2026 electoral landscape.

item.title: Cury quer primeiro-ministro com ‘mente capitalista notável’ e revela conversas com Mansueto e Lisboa
item.description: Presidential candidate Augusto Cury (Avante) advocates for creating a prime minister with a 'notable capitalist mind' to modernize Brazil's government. He criticizes presidentialism for concentrating decisions in leaders without technical experience and proposes a split between president (foreign policy) and prime minister (economic management). Cury also mentions talks with economists like Mansueto Almeida and Marcos Lisboa to form a diverse technical team.

item.title: Defesa de Vorcaro vai contestar delações de Mineiro e Mansur
item.description: Daniel Vorcaro's defense will challenge the plea bargains of Antonio Carlos Freixo Júnior and João Carlos Mansur, claiming the information was already submitted in proposals rejected by the PGR. The plea bargains reveal alleged bribe payments and money laundering linked to the Master case, involving political figures such as Flávio Bolsonaro.

item.title: Veja como foi a quarta-feira (9) dos presidenciáveis
item.description: On Wednesday (9), the presidential candidates carried out various campaign activities, including rallies, institutional visits, and public events. Topics ranged from the privatization of companies, education and technology, to social issues such as violence against women and stances on abortion and drugs.

item.title: Perfil seguido por Lula resgata vídeo de Júlia Zanatta
item.description: The profile 'Pesquisas e Análises Eleições', followed by Lula's official Instagram account, shared 2014 video of deputy Júlia Zanatta dancing in Ibiza. The Santa Catarina Electoral Court ordered removal of the posts for falsely attributing authorship of the content.

item.title: Entenda as 3 decisões de Fachin durante crise no STF
item.description: The president of the Supreme Federal Court, Edson Fachin, decided to remove Alexandre de Moraes from the fake news investigation and suspend conflicting decisions regarding the leadership of the Federal Police, centralizing case management under the STF presidency. These measures aim to reorganize the internal crisis among ministers of the Court. The decisions were made to prevent institutional conflicts and ensure the continuity of investigations without compromising impartiality.

item.title: Diário Oficial confirma exoneração de Bruno Dantas do TCU após renúncia
item.description: Bruno Dantas was dismissed from the TCU after resigning on August 31st, after 12 years in office. His departure opened a vacancy for Rodrigo Pacheco, indicated by the President of the Senate Davi Alcolumbre.

item.title: AGU e Ministério da Justiça apoiam decisões de Fachin sobre PF: ‘restaura a ordem pública’
item.description: The President of the STF, Edson Fachin, suspended decisions to remove the head of the Federal Police, reaffirming the prerogative of the President of the Republic to appoint and dismiss directors. The AGU and the Ministry of Justice supported the decision, highlighting its importance for public order, administrative order, and the independence of PF investigations.

item.title: Fachin tenta retomar controle do STF, freia Mendonça e Dino e impõe revés a Moraes
item.description: STF President Edson Fachin suspended decisions by Flávio Dino and André Mendonça in the fake news investigation, attempting to regain institutional control amid internal Court crisis. The measure directly impacts Minister Alexandre de Moraes, who loses the case rapporteurship, signaling disagreement with his unilateral actions.

item.title: Caso “Dark Horse”: delação de Mineiro não assusta a campanha de Flávio
item.description: Antonio Carlos Freire Júnior's ('Mineiro') plea deal regarding 'Dark Horse' film funding had limited impact on Flávio Bolsonaro's campaign after preliminary analysis found no material irregularities. The case involves R$69 million transfers to Havengate fund under COAF supervision.

item.title: Michelle entra de vez na campanha de Flávio Bolsonaro e convoca ‘Exército rosa’ para eleger enteado
item.description: Michelle Bolsonaro (PL) re-engages in Flávio Bolsonaro’s presidential campaign, spearheading a strategy to mobilize PL Mulher leaders across states to court female voters. Following a prior public conflict with her stepson, she publicly backs the candidate, emphasizing her care for husband Jair Bolsonaro, who is under house arrest.

item.title: Oposição pressiona e pede a Fachin arquivamento do inquérito das fake news
item.description: The opposition, led by the Novo party, pressured Minister Edson Fachin to shelve the Fake News investigation. The party also requested the Supreme Court to remove the Director-General of the Federal Police, Andrei Rodrigues.

item.title: Lula conversou com Fachin na véspera das decisões do ministro sobre Andrei
item.description: Ahead of Fachin's decisions regarding Andrei, Lula held a phone call with the STF president, receiving signals about the crisis between the Court and the Federal Police. The conversation occurred after André Mendonça's order to remove Andrei Rodrigues from the PF directorate.

item.title: O que acontece fora do STF tem grande peso na disputa interna de poder
item.description: The STF debate over Moraes investigations reflects the struggle for control over security institutions, with implications for political stability and public perception of corruption. The Court faces criticism for acting as a political entity, losing legitimacy.

item.title: Decisões de Dino e de Mendonça sobre chefe da PF anuladas por Fachin tinham hierarquia? Entenda
item.description: Monocratic decisions by STF ministers regarding the head of the Federal Police do not have hierarchy among themselves, even if one effectively overturns the other, according to experts cited by Folha. The lack of hierarchy stems from the monocratic nature and individual character of Supreme Court decisions.

item.title: Lula atua nos bastidores para conter crise no STF e faz inflexão no discurso de campanha
item.description: Lula works behind the scenes to contain the crisis at the STF and shifts his campaign rhetoric, demanding full disclosure of investigations related to the Banco Master case. The president seeks to distance himself from the scandal involving Minister Alexandre de Moraes and tries to stem a decline in voter preference polls.

item.title: Michelle convoca ‘Exército Rosa’ para ajudar campanha de Flávio Bolsonaro
item.description: Michelle Bolsonaro announced the creation of the 'Pink Army' to mobilize female voters in support of Flávio Bolsonaro's presidential campaign, following a public reconciliation between the two. The former first lady emphasized women's role in supporting the PL and invited 'all good women' to back Flávio, while justifying her absence from recent events due to caring for Jair Bolsonaro.

item.title: Flávio faz motociata e comício em palco de atentado a Bolsonaro e aproveita para criticar Dino
item.description: Flávio Bolsonaro held a rally in Juiz de Fora, MG, and used the event to criticize Supreme Court minister Flávio Dino and comment on the ongoing STF crisis, while highlighting growth in polling data. He also referenced the stabbing attack on his father, Jair Bolsonaro, as motivation for his political engagement.

item.title: Decisão de Fachin de cancelar sessão não foi informada antes a ministros do STF
item.description: The president of the STF, Edson Fachin, decided to cancel the session scheduled for Wednesday (9) without previously informing the court's ministers, surprising members of the tribunal. The decision generated reactions of surprise and questions about the transparency of the decision-making process at the STF.

item.title: Lula e Flávio Bolsonaro na pesquisa para presidente: veja números recentes
item.description: Recent polls for the 2026 presidential election show Lula (PT) and Flávio Bolsonaro (PL) leading in voter intention, though numbers vary across institutes and scenarios tested. The race is still in its early stages with significant room for shifts in electoral dynamics.

item.title: Michelle publica vídeo convocando apoio do Éxercito Rosa a Flávio Bolsonaro
item.description: Michelle Bolsonaro led a campaign organized by PL Mulher to support PL Senate candidate Flávio Bolsonaro for the Federal District, featuring videos from female party representatives. The first video was presented by Priscila Costa from Ceará, alongside supporters from multiple states, despite internal disagreements. Michelle takes on this role after stepping down from PL Mulher leadership in June.

item.title: Caiado celebra Moraes fora do inquérito das fake news
item.description: Ronaldo Caiado praised Edson Fachin's decision to remove Alexandre de Moraes from the fake news inquiry, calling it a positive step and proper for the STF.

item.title: Governo estima gastar R$ 7 bi no mês com subsídios e pagar uma parte com petróleo
item.description: The federal government announced fuel tax relief measures costing an estimated R$ 7 billion per month to mitigate cost shocks from the Iran war. The economic team projected additional revenue of R$ 10 billion due to rising oil prices, but warned about the risk of exceeding the fiscal target.

item.title: Subsídios à gasolina e ao diesel são ampliados após alta do petróleo
item.description: The Lula administration expanded subsidies for gasoline and diesel following the international oil price surge, cutting taxes on gasoline and authorizing an initial R$1 per liter subsidy for diesel. These measures aim to cushion the impact of global volatility on domestic prices and account for Brazil's reliance on fuel imports.

item.title: Temer diz que preservar integridade do STF é "questão de sobrevivência"
item.description: Former President Michel Temer stated that preserving the integrity of the STF is a matter of survival for the Republic, advocating for internal resolution of conflicts between court ministers. His remarks came after decisions were suspended regarding conflicting rulings on the leadership of the Federal Police, involving ministers André Mendonça and Flávio Dino. Temer emphasized the importance of prioritizing institutions over individuals to ensure harmony among the branches of government.

item.title: Michelle convoca PL Mulher para formar “Exército Rosa” por Flávio
item.description: Michelle Bolsonaro, former first lady and Senate candidate, urged PL Mulher leaders nationwide to form an 'Army of Pink' to support Flávio Bolsonaro's presidential bid. She emphasized the role of women's mobilization within the party in a video.

item.title: Santos anuncia a contratação de Everton Cebolinha, do Flamengo
item.description: Santos officially signed Everton Cebolinha from Flamengo as their fourth reinforcement this season, taking over the iconic number 7 jersey. The left winger joins with 12 appearances, one goal, and two assists this year. The team faces Atlético-MG in the Copa Sudamericana while fighting relegation in the Brasileirão.

item.title: Presidenciáveis reagem à decisão de Fachin que mantém Andrei na PF e tira Moraes do inquérito das fake news
item.description: STF president Edson Fachin kept Andrei Rodrigues in the Federal Police and removed Alexandre de Moraes from the fake news investigation, prompting reactions from presidential candidates such as Renan Santos, Romeu Zema, and Ronaldo Caiado, who criticized the internal crisis at the Supreme Court.

item.title: Arena Mané Garrincha, em Brasília, receberá a final da Copa do Brasil 2026
item.description: The Mané Garrincha Arena in Brasília was selected by the CBF to host the 2026 Copa do Brasil final, which will be played in a single match on December 6th. The decision was announced during the semifinal draw, where Atlético-MG faces Grêmio and Palmeiras plays against Vasco. The Federal District governor, Celina Leão, offered the stadium for the event, highlighting the city's infrastructure and football history.

item.title: Os argumentos de Fachin para anular a decisão de André Mendonça sobre diretor-geral da PF
item.description: Justice Edson Fachin suspended Minister André Mendonça's decision removing two Federal Police directors amid an internal Supreme Court conflict linked to Operation Compliance Zero. Mendonça had reacted to reports questioning his conduct, while the Attorney General opposed his actions. Flávio Dino later overturned the removal of the directors.

item.title: Guerra Moraes x Mendonça: o que Fachin decidiu e o que acontece agora com os ministros do STF
item.description: STF President Edson Fachin convened a plenary session for September 15 to address the institutional crisis caused by conflicting rulings from justices Alexandre de Moraes, André Mendonça, and Flávio Dino. He suspended case 16.662, which examined alleged conversations between Moraes and banker Daniel Vorcaro, and revoked the order naming Moraes as rapporteur of the 2019 Fake News Inquiry. The PGR requested the annulment of Mendonça’s proceedings against Moraes, arguing he exceeded his judicial role.

item.title: Sul-Americana: reforços fazem estreia por Santos e Atlético-MG nas quartas
item.description: Santos and Atlético-MG face off in the first leg of the Copa Sudamericana quarterfinals, missing key players like Neymar, Everson, and Cuello. The match marks Rodinei's debut with Santos and Gabriel Bontempo's call-up to the Brazilian national team. The decisive clash takes place at Vila Belmiro, with the second leg in Belo Horizonte determining who advances to the semifinals.

item.title: Governo amplia desoneração da gasolina para R$ 0,63 por litro
item.description: The federal government expanded gasoline tax relief from R$0.44 to R$0.63 per liter, impacting R$1.7 billion monthly. For ethanol, the R$0.19 per liter benefit zeroes federal taxes, totaling R$2 billion. President Lula also authorized a R$1.00 per liter subsidy for diesel, with an estimated monthly cost of R$5 billion.

item.title: A decisão que falta para Fachin retomar de vez o comando do STF
item.description: Edson Fachin took charge of the crisis at the STF by suspending conflicting decisions from André Mendonça and Flávio Dino regarding the Federal Police leadership, keeping Andrei Rodrigues and Leandro Almada in their positions. He also removed Alexandre de Moraes from handling the fake news investigation, transferring responsibility to the STF Presidency. The move weakens both Mendonça and Moraes, but it remains unclear who will handle politically sensitive cases involving the Banco Master and INSS fraud.

item.title: TRE-PR mantém propaganda que diz que Moro votou em Dino
item.description: The TRE-PR upheld an electoral advertisement claiming Sergio Moro voted in favor of Flávio Dino's nomination to the STF, ruling that the secret vote cannot be objectively verified. The decision rejected requests to remove the ad, stating there is no way to prove or disprove the direction of the vote.

item.title: Alexandre de Moraes perder o inquérito das fake news chega tarde e não estanca a hemorragia suprema
item.description: The decision by STF president Edson Fachin to move the fake news investigation from Minister Alexandre de Moraes to Minister André Mendonça comes too late to prevent the already entrenched political fallout. The crisis within the Supreme Court, heightened by revelations about Moraes’ ties to Daniel Vorcaro, keeps the judiciary in turmoil, indirectly benefiting figures like Flávio Bolsonaro. Despite attempts at internal restructuring, the STF remains weakened amid a severe legitimacy crisis.

item.title: Aliados de Mendonça comemoram decisão de Fachin que suspende procedimento da PGR
item.description: Supporters of Minister André Mendonça celebrated the decision by STF President Edson Fachin to suspend an inquiry opened by the PGR into Federal Police reports. The ruling halts an investigation involving figures close to the minister, prompting relief among Mendonça's allies.

item.title: Como demonstrou Dino, não podemos naturalizar a violência, mesmo a institucional
item.description: The text reflects on the importance of civility in politics, highlighting the role of Minister Flávio Dino and criticizing the normalization of violence, even institutional. It emphasizes that democracy requires respect and cordiality, even in the face of opponents, and draws historical parallels with Italy to illustrate party cooperation.
